keyword: DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow

title.en: Ring a Ring o' Roses names the sections; DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《Ring a Ring o' Roses》只提供章节，DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow仍用已印格子

description.en: The DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow note follows the outline of Ring a Ring o' Roses. The DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow is a wear elbow from Xingtai. The label prints dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe, DN200, R275 and 90°, with a triangular mounting bracket. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a truck-mounted boom pump. This elbow page is not a statement that every trailer outlet is DN200.
description.zh: DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow这篇笔记顺着《Ring a Ring o' Roses》的大纲写。DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管是邢台的易损弯管。铭牌印混凝土泵车专用管、DN200、R275、90°，并带三角安装支架。河北品锦机械没有列出车载臂架泵。这一弯管页不是在说每台拖泵出口都是 DN200。

h1.en: How Ring a Ring o' Roses arranges a note that only repeats DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow
h1.zh: 《Ring a Ring o' Roses》怎样安排一篇只重复DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow的笔记

directAnswer.en: For DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Ring a Ring o' Roses. Ring a Ring o' Roses only lends its headings. The DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow is a wear elbow from Xingtai. The label prints dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe, DN200, R275 and 90°, with a triangular mounting bracket. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a truck-mounted boom pump. This elbow page is not a statement that every trailer outlet is DN200.
directAnswer.zh: 写DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Ring a Ring o' Roses》借数字。《Ring a Ring o' Roses》只出借标题。 DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管是邢台的易损弯管。铭牌印混凝土泵车专用管、DN200、R275、90°，并带三角安装支架。河北品锦机械没有列出车载臂架泵。这一弯管页不是在说每台拖泵出口都是 DN200。

body.en: “Song” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Part type is a concrete pump elbow. Nominal diameter is DN200. Bend is 90° / R275. The label reads dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe. Mounting is a heel bracket with a fixing hole. Commercial terms: no small-batch shipping and no published list price. Wall thickness, material grade and service life are not printed. No second elbow diameter is published as its own page. Electric 20 prints 80 mm. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm. Integrated Mixer Pump, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 print 100 / 125 mm. None of those cells is DN200. The elbow stays on its own page. A trailer pump inquiry for straight pipe still uses the delivery-pipe page and that pump's own diameter cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Name DN200 R275 90°, the quantity, and the pump you are matching. If the pump page has no DN200 cell, say that the match is not printed. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: “来源章节：Song”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 配件类型是混凝土泵弯管。公称直径 DN200。弯曲为 90° / R275。铭牌是混凝土泵车专用管。安装是带固定孔的弯头支架。商务条款：不支持小批量发货，无公开标价。壁厚、材料牌号和寿命没有印出。没有第二种弯管直径的独立产品页。 电动20印 80 mm。电动15印 100–125 mm。搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 印 100 / 125 mm。这些格子都不是 DN200。弯管留在自己的页面。拖泵直管询价仍走输送管页，并使用该泵自己的管径格。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明 DN200、R275、90°、数量，以及准备对照的泵。若该泵页没有 DN200 这一格，写明目录没有印出对应关系。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Paintings”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. The DN200 90° Concrete Pump Elbow is a wear elbow from Xingtai. The label prints dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe, DN200, R275 and 90°, with a triangular mounting bracket. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a truck-mounted boom pump. This elbow page is not a statement that every trailer outlet is DN200. No. The elbow page is DN200. The six printed trailer and mixer pipe cells are 80 mm, 100–125 mm or 100 / 125 mm. No truck-mounted boom pump is published. The elbow label says dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe. That label is not a model page. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“来源章节：Paintings”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 DN200 90度混凝土泵弯管是邢台的易损弯管。铭牌印混凝土泵车专用管、DN200、R275、90°，并带三角安装支架。河北品锦机械没有列出车载臂架泵。这一弯管页不是在说每台拖泵出口都是 DN200。 不是。弯管页是 DN200。六台已印管径的拖泵和搅拌泵是 80 mm、100–125 mm 或 100 / 125 mm。 没有公布车载臂架泵。弯管铭牌写混凝土泵车专用管。铭牌不是型号页。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Origin theories” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. R275 and 90° are printed. Wall thickness is a missing field. Service life is a missing field. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Unprinted cells stay unprinted. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ring_a_Ring_o'_Roses
body.zh: “来源章节：Origin theories”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 印出的是 R275 和 90°。壁厚是缺字段。寿命是缺字段。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 没有印出的格子保持不印。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ring_a_Ring_o'_Roses

question.en: Can the outline heading “Origin theories” rename DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow?
question.zh: 大纲标题“来源章节：Origin theories”可以改掉DN200 R275 90 degree concrete pump elbow的名称吗？

answer.en: No. The elbow page is DN200. The six printed trailer and mixer pipe cells are 80 mm, 100–125 mm or 100 / 125 mm. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。弯管页是 DN200。六台已印管径的拖泵和搅拌泵是 80 mm、100–125 mm 或 100 / 125 mm。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

answer.en: No truck-mounted boom pump is published. The elbow label says dedicated concrete pump-truck pipe. That label is not a model page. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 没有公布车载臂架泵。弯管铭牌写混凝土泵车专用管。铭牌不是型号页。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
